residual_limits: The destination-tail and absent-placement controls are the completed fixed reference fixture rather than mutations across all 48 expanded cases.

The member-oracle mutation was independently exercised in the completed reference verifier; the expanded validator binds complete canonical case definitions and exact event cardinality but does not contain a second member-only mutation adapter.
Execution supervision tests run locally on the shared WSL2 host and are not hard real-time guarantees.
open_questions: Should a later L2 successor add dedicated member-only and placement-only mutation adapters across the full 48-case denominator?
